name: Disneyland Jolly Holiday Famous Matterhorn Macaroon (Coconut & White Chocolate)
whyItWorks: Shredded sweet coconut baked golden in the shape of the Matterhorn mountain, dipped in white chocolate to resemble snow. Completely seed-free (unlike the Raspberry Rose Macaron).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Matterhorn Macaroon as your seed-free Disney bakery treat.
